title: GTA 6 set Comcast's all-time traffic record 📈
subject: gta6
description:
Did your download crawl on launch day? 👇

Comcast says the launch of Grand Theft Auto VI drove the biggest internet traffic day in its network history, 31% above an average day, and that at peak GTA 6 accounted for nearly a quarter of all traffic on its network. GTA 6 released November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Sources: Comcast on X (Nov 2026), PC Gamer (Nov 21, 2026), Briefs (Nov 21, 2026)
Game images © Rockstar Games.

scenes.text: GTA 6 just set Comcast's all-time traffic record.
Comcast says the launch drove the biggest internet traffic day in its network history, 31% above an average day.
Its chart marks November 19, the day the game came out on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
At the peak, GTA 6 alone made up nearly a quarter of everything moving across Comcast's network.
That's one provider, not the whole internet. Still, it's the busiest day Comcast has ever recorded.
